agent_notes: All four supplied 2025 NIRF government directories were independently fetched and each contained Bareilly International University with city BAREILLY and state Uttar Pradesh.

The official homepage, About page, Contact page, central Programmes Offered catalogue, and linked discipline pages were fetched directly from biu.edu.in; the catalogue and discipline pages were cross-checked for programme names.
The official catalogue does not centrally state duration, eligibility, or delivery mode for these entries, so those fields remain null or not_stated; no brochure-only facts were imported.
The catalogue lists Bachelor of Pharmacy and D.Pharma under two constituent pharmacy colleges; duplicate names were represented once in the institution-level course list.
No unnamed certificate programme was invented from the Forensic Sciences page's generic statement that forensic science may be offered at certificate level.

Normal TLS verification failed with the managed proxy's exact self-signed certificate-chain error; --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected NIRF, biu.edu.in, and Bing hostnames.
Search-engine results were used only to discover the official domain; official-site pages, not search snippets or aggregators, support the verified record and courses.
career_path.db was queried read-only. The database's exact career-tree label 'Medical Updated' was retained for the bpharm node and flagged with the label-issue mapping status.
